purpose: Exact model-facing serialization contract for AgenticStudyAdapter. Semantic drafts may use other shapes temporarily; final files may not.

semantics: analysis contains only useful evidence about this specific object, written for a non-technical reader
analysis is an empty string when the document has no meaningful object-specific finding
coordinates, identifiers, table positions, list membership, missing-data statements, and shared layer conclusions do not by themselves qualify as object-specific analysis
an empty analysis makes a point non-interactive; its geometry may still contribute to coverage or aggregate layers
The identity fields describe the document faithfully and in plain language.
blocks is an ordered, document-shaped narrative; no topic or block count is mandatory.
Omit empty blocks, empty metric arrays, and fields that add no useful information.
Do not create a block merely to discuss absent data, schema coverage, provenance mechanics, or uncertainty.
All factual claims and metrics must be supported by evidence_refs.

block.note: headline is a short factual one-liner. content is clear Markdown of any useful length. Retain the block only when content or at least one metric is useful.

metric.note: Metrics are optional evidence-backed callouts. display_value is presentation-ready text, including its unit or category. Never invent a metric to fill a layout.

structured_resource.note: The current adapter does not preserve inline rows. Write durable JSON/CSV data under the run directory and set path when row content must reach the UI.

semantics: Use one point per source-backed observation or explicitly labelled deterministic derivation.
Preserve dates, categories, groups, units, ranges, thresholds, missing values, and evidence references rather than flattening them into prose.
Never combine incompatible parameters or units in one series.
Do not interpolate missing observations or convert missing values to zero.
Use feature_id, observation_id, or dataset_id when a chart point can link back to another UI object.
The schema is domain-neutral and applies to any quantitative source.

requirements: The adapted report retains its identity fields and ordered non-empty blocks.
Empty optional block fields and empty metric groups are omitted rather than padded.
Every displayed metric has a label, presentation-ready value, and evidence reference.
Every intended quantitative visualization survives adaptation with its numeric points, dimensions, units, links, and evidence references intact.
Only features with non-empty, evidence-backed object-specific analysis become interactive points.
Structured resources have human names and usable durable paths.
